newsitem.title: JAPAN: Clarion falls as margin settlement nears.
newsitem.headline: Clarion falls as margin settlement nears.

text.p: Shares of Clarion Co Ltd continued falling on Thursday morning as the settlement date for margin trading approached, traders said.

"The company is expected to largely boost its profits in the year to March 31, 1997, but Clarion shares are being sold as the shares' demand-and-supply situation is not good," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
"Selling of issues for which settlement dates of margin trading are nearing is active and that is hitting market sentiment," another trader said.
Clarion was down 20 yen at 560 by 0131 GMT. Turnover was 1.45 million shares.
